response.sql: WITH team_averages AS (SELECT team_id, 1.0 * SUM(w) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT year), 0) AS average_wins, AVG(1.0 * (g - l) / NULLIF(l, 0)) AS average_games_minus_losses_per_loss FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS mean_average_wins FROM team_averages) SELECT t.team_id, t.average_wins, t.average_games_minus_losses_per_loss, t.average_wins - o.mean_average_wins AS gap FROM team_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE t.average_wins > o.mean_average_wins ORDER BY gap DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Each manager_half row contributes one value to the games-minus-losses ratio average. A season with a known year counts toward the wins denominator even if its wins value is missing; SUM and AVG ignore missing inputs, and a zero loss count makes that row's ratio undefined.
